section.title: Activity
section.para: Each of the scatter plots shows a strong relationship. Write a sentence or two describing how you think the variables are related.

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample.
When there is more rain, it is more likely people will wear jackets.

problem.para: 1. During the month of April, Elena keeps track of the number of inches of rain, or precipitation, recorded for the day and the percentage of people who come to school with rain jackets.

image.alt: A scatterplot. Percentage with jackets. Precipitation in inches.

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample.
Longer books will take more time to read.

problem.para: 2. A school book club has a list of 100 books for its members to read. They keep track of the number of pages in the books the members read from the list and the amount of time it took to read the book.

image.alt: A scatterplot. Number of pages. Time in hours.

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample.
When more tickets are left, the party will have fewer people to have loud conversations, so it will be quieter.

problem.para: 3. Number of tickets left for holiday parties at a venue and noise level at the party

image.alt: A scatterplot, Noise level in decibels. Number of tickets left.

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample.
Children who are taller are usually older, so they have had more time to be in school and learn more vocabulary.

problem.para: 4. The height and score on a test of vocabulary for several children ages 6 to 13

image.alt: A scatterplot. Vocabulary test score in percent. Height in inches.

div.para: One of the most powerful tools you can give a farmer to help improve their crop is statistics. Statistics can help farmers at every stage. For example, seeds are expensive, and if you plant too many strawberries in a market where there are hundreds of strawberry farmers, you might not sell enough to make a profit. With statistical models, farmers can use demand to precisely calculate the proper amount of crops to plant.
